summary.value: When another player character acts from cowardice, cruelty, fear, or despair, they earn 1 FP as normal.

system.description: When another player character acts from cowardice, cruelty, fear, or despair, they earn 1 FP as normal. You may then choose to sour or strengthen your Bond with them — whichever is honest — as a cost or reward for being right.
